mechanism_comparison.totient_reindexing: For each n>=2, the ordered pairs a,b>=1 with a+b=n and gcd(a,b)=1 are counted by phi(n), because gcd(a,n-a)=gcd(a,n).
mechanism_comparison.classical_reduction: Thus L(r)=sum_{n>=2}phi(n)r^n/(1-r^n). Subtracting the n=1 term r/(1-r) from the classical total r/(1-r)^2 gives r^2/(1-r)^2=(r/(1-r))^2.
mechanism_comparison.visible_layer_reduction: Alternatively, expand each Lambert kernel and use the unique decomposition (m,n)=g(a,b) of every positive lattice point into gcd and primitive direction.
mechanism_comparison.significance_boundary: Both proofs are standard. The durable local value is the exact formal no-go consumer, not a new Lambert-series theorem.
